# GUI Discussion Builder Capability Contract

## 1) Purpose
The *GUI Discussion Builder* enables developers to discuss existing or planned GUI parts by:

- Overlaying the current app screen with editable “regions”.
- Storing rich-text notes per region.
- Persisting regions inside a “view” (a discussion/scratch canvas).
- Supporting developer execution linkage (implementation references) and a `DONE` workflow state.

This repository delivers the TPLK pilot (frontend overlay + backend `/api/gui-specs` endpoints). The contract below is intended to be reused by other apps so the semantics stay consistent.

## 2) Conceptual Objects

### 2.1 GUI Spec View (`GUI_SPEC_VIEW`)
A persisted discussion container.

Key fields:
- `id`
- `name`, `description`
- `view_type` (v1 uses `SCRATCH_VIEW`)
- `capture_url`, `capture_gui_part`, `capture_state_json` (UI context for reopening)

### 2.2 GUI Spec Region (`GUI_SPEC_REGION`)
A persisted rectangular region anchored to a GUI part.

Key fields:
- `id`, `view_id`
- `region_type`: `EXISTING_PART` or `NEW_PART`
- `label`
- Anchor metadata for `EXISTING_PART`:
  - `anchor_selector`, `anchor_id`, `anchor_class_name`, `anchor_tag`, `anchor_text_sample`
- Geometry stored as viewport-relative percentages scaled by `1000`:
  - `left_pct`, `top_pct`, `width_pct`, `height_pct`
- `z_index` for overlap stacking
- `status`: `OPEN`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`

### 2.3 GUI Spec Note (`GUI_SPEC_NOTE`)
Rich-text (minimal formatting supported by the frontend editor) persisted per region.

Key fields:
- `id`, `region_id` (1:1)
- `rich_text_html`

### 2.4 GUI Spec Implementation Link (`GUI_SPEC_IMPL_LINK`)
An optional persisted reference to related code.

Key fields:
- `id`, `region_id` (1:1)
- `repo_key`, `module_path`, `file_path`, `symbol`, `commit_hash`
- `note`

## 3) Overlap Handling (v1 UX Semantics)
- Regions can overlap.
- `z_index` is the canonical stacking order.
- UI selection is “topmost first” by relying on z-order in rendering (frontend picks the region under the click at its z-index position).

No server-side overlap resolution is required for v1; the server persists geometry + z-index.

## 4) DONE State Semantics
- Regions with `status = DONE` are hidden by default in region lists and overlay rendering.
- A UI toggle can include DONE regions for review.

The `DONE` transition does not delete regions, notes, or implementation links.

## 5) API Contract (TPLK Pilot)
Base path: `/api/gui-specs`

Authorization:
- Service requires a developer role key `DEV`.
- Endpoints are available in `DEV/TEST` mode (v1 guardrail).

### 5.1 Views
- `GET /views?include_done={bool}`
  - Returns a list of views with counts: `open_regions_count`, `done_regions_count`.
  - v1 list summary does not require region inclusion.
- `POST /views`
  - Creates a new view.
  - Payload: `name`, `description`, `view_type`, `capture_url`, `capture_gui_part`, `capture_state_json`.
- `GET /views/{view_id}`
  - Returns full view details (including capture context for reopening).

### 5.2 Regions
- `GET /views/{view_id}/regions?include_done={bool}`
  - Returns regions ordered by `z_index`, including `note` and `impl_link` details when present.
- `POST /views/{view_id}/regions`
  - Creates a region with:
    - `region_type`, `label`
    - anchor metadata (for `EXISTING_PART`)
    - geometry percent fields (scaled by `1000`)
    - optional `z_index`, `status`
- `PATCH /regions/{region_id}/note`
  - Updates/creates the region’s `GUI_SPEC_NOTE`.
- `PATCH /regions/{region_id}/status`
  - Updates region status (`OPEN`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`).

### 5.3 Implementation Links
- `PUT /regions/{region_id}/impl-link`
  - Creates or updates the region’s `GUI_SPEC_IMPL_LINK` (1:1 upsert).

## 6) Navigation / Reopening Context
Each view stores capture context (`capture_url`, `capture_gui_part`, `capture_state_json`).

The pilot reuses the existing *Dev Forum* navigation/capture event mechanism so reopening a saved GUI spec view navigates back to the stored app context before overlay rendering.

## 7) Migration Path from Pilot
To adopt this capability in another app:
1. Implement backend persistence with the same v1 entities and field semantics (`GUI_SPEC_*`).
2. Implement the same `/api/gui-specs/*` endpoints and request/response shapes.
3. Reuse the same frontend editor component contract (rich-text HTML stored in `GUI_SPEC_NOTE`).
4. Preserve DONE default filtering behavior and overlap semantics (`z_index`).
5. Ensure the app stores capture context on view creation so reopened discussions remain aligned with the originating UI geometry.
